rapport_notes: Warm, conversational tone; acknowledges prior positive experience; patient with address/zip-code correction; professional and personable throughout.
process_discipline_notes: Rep did not hold silence after the estimate/window explanation ('Does that all make sense?' received immediate re-pitch rather than pause for customer response).

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: I'll just start with a few questions to get us on the right track. That should only take about six minutes and they'll be able to build you quote you can depend on
evidence_quotes.agenda: And then do you have any specific specific questions or concerns about the move that you'd like answered on this call?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised wrapping/padding concern; rep answered it directly ('wrapping and padding everything is included in our hourly rate') but did not probe deeper ('tell me more about that' or 'what else'). No follow-up to explore if there were other concerns beyond the wrapping mention.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: We have that no worries damage coverage. Which is our free evaluation coverage included in our hourly rate that provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: A few days before your move. You'll receive a meet your mover email introducing them to you helping ease attention of strangers arriving at your front door.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We do have our on time guarantee we value your time. So, if we don't make it in the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill
evidence_quotes.communication: We'll call you the day before the move and then we'll call you the morning of letting you know we are on our way.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: In typical move the size would take between two and a half to three and a half hours, since you're moving from that 800 square foot apartment on the nineteenth floor with the elevator access with a bit of a walk. I would estimate your time to between three and four hours.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_commit: There are no hidden fees, no credit card fees, no stairwell fees.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_window: There, there's no deposit required to get on our schedule, no charges to change dates or cancel.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_beats_it: The time is prorated in fifteen minute increments... if we can do it in the minimum hour, the two and a half hours then you only pay for the minimum.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_self_prep: Even if you do have the ability to take a smaller things over yourself in a car load or two. That would really help keep the time down in our efficiency up obviously less time we take, the less money you end up at spending at the end of the day.
evidence_quotes.close_issue: Rep closed with confirmation email and call logistics but never explicitly asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent rate-lock framing; customer volunteered booking without rep's formal close ask.

top_strength: Rep nailed the quid-pro-quo framing, asked the agenda question before probing, covered all four differentiators in valid slots, and delivered a personalized estimate anchor that matched the customer's specific logistics (19th floor, elevator, square footage).
coaching_note: Go two layers deep on concerns — when the customer mentioned wrapping, ask 'what else is on your mind about the move?' rather than answer and pivot; also hold silence after open-ended questions (especially the estimate window explanation) and always close with an explicit rate-lock + ask ('your rate locks when you book — would you like our help with your move?').
